video_title: GREATEST COMEBACK EVER!! Game 4 REACTION: Knicks’ Epic Comeback To Beat Spurs

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' playoff comeback success and conditioning the home crowd
quotes.excerpt: they've conditioned their crowd to never give up
quotes.quote: This is the fifth Knicks comeback in the playoffs of over 20 points in the last two years. They've conditioned their crowd to never give up.

quotes.speaker: Ben McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' resilience and ability to overcome deficits
quotes.excerpt: they are the ultimate NBA cockroaches. You can't just step on them. You got to squish them.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are the ultimate NBA cockroaches. You can't just step on them. You got to squish them and then you got to flush them. They do not die.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's questionable rotation decisions in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown, with all due respect, is all over the place. He played 12 men in the first 14 minutes.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown, with all due respect, is all over the place. He played 12 men in the first 14 minutes, playing Jeremy Sochan, playing Aris Hukporti.

quotes.speaker: Ben McMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's lack of involvement in the second half
quotes.excerpt: the youngest guy on the court was the guy who needed the ball and he didn't get it.
quotes.quote: The only guy who had any sort of juice going at all in the second half was Dylan Harper, and he vanished into the woodwork. Frankly, the youngest guy on the court was the guy who needed the ball and he didn't get it.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson's poor usage of Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Mitch Johnson was inexcusable with his usage of Victor Wembanyama in this game.
quotes.quote: Mitch Johnson was inexcusable with his usage of Victor Wembanyama in this game. The Spurs were on tilt in this game, even though they were winning.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's fatigue and lack of impact in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: he plays 23 minutes in the second half and he was completely on empty the entire fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: He plays 23 minutes in the second half and he was completely on empty the entire fourth quarter, and so he was often times standing there on the perimeter watching straight line drives to the rim for layups and kickouts for threes.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's physical struggles and balance issues
quotes.excerpt: you kind of see Victor's fatigue sometimes when you start seeing him lose his balance.
quotes.quote: You kind of see Victor's fatigue sometimes when you start seeing him lose his balance. His strength has been to keep his balance because he's so tall. He's losing his balance, he's sort of flopping all over the place out there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Officiating inconsistency regarding Jose Alvarado and Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: how do we feel about Alvarado not getting a flagrant for basically grabbing his leg and cutting him out?
quotes.quote: How do we feel about Alvarado not getting a flagrant for basically grabbing his leg and cutting him out, and then Victor getting a flagrant later on for like an accidental elbow?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's recurring immaturity and need for growth
quotes.excerpt: there's a streak of immaturity in Victor. For all of his attributes, he's got a streak of immaturity.
quotes.quote: There's a streak of immaturity in Victor. For all of his attributes, he's got a streak of immaturity, and he showed it with that whole act out there.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' lack of secondary ball-handlers and reliance on Brunson
quotes.excerpt: part of the reason Jalen Brunson pounds the ball too much is there are not a lot of secondary ball-handlers.
quotes.quote: Part of the reason Jalen Brunson pounds the ball too much is there are not a lot of secondary ball-handlers on the team. If you have Landry Shamet out there, or Deuce McBride out there, or a bunch of these different guys, none of them are really good ball-handlers to sort of take over the offense. By having Jose Alvarado as a short roll option, they kept running these small small screens at the top of the court.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's case for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: OG Anunoby, if we had to vote right now, would have my vote for MVP of the Finals.
quotes.quote: OG Anunoby, if we had to vote right now, would have my vote for MVP of the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: OG Anunoby's improved physical health during the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: one of the things that we have seen in the series is how much healthier his hamstring is.
quotes.quote: One of the things that we have seen in the series is how much healthier his hamstring is than it was when he came back in the conference finals.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The chaotic sequence leading to the Knicks' final possession
quotes.excerpt: Brunson goes to the basket and there's a goddamn car accident at the basket.
quotes.quote: Brunson goes to the basket and there's a goddamn car accident at the basket. Brunson's on the floor, Anunoby's on the floor. There's a ball bounces and there's another collision to get the ball.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's poor decision-making on the final layup
quotes.excerpt: it looked like De'Aaron Fox was way ahead of the field and had a wide open layup.
quotes.quote: It looked like De'Aaron Fox was way ahead of the field and had a wide open layup. So he went into to take the wide open layup, and OG, who was way behind the play, literally dead sprinted, got back in the play and got there to block the shot somehow.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's questionable decision to commit a take foul
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox decides to grab him for a take foul when Jose Alvarado is going backwards.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox decides to grab him for a take foul when Jose Alvarado is going backwards away from the basket and nothing good is happening.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's lack of awareness during the final possession
quotes.excerpt: I'm not even sure that he knew he hadn't gone over the yet.
quotes.quote: I'm not even sure that he knew he hadn't gone over the yet. He was almost a triple team because he almost thought he had the half court guarding him and the two guys.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's impressive shooting performance in Game 4
quotes.excerpt: Dylan Harper was eight of 12 shooting in this game and never showed any fear.
quotes.quote: Dylan Harper was eight of 12 shooting in this game and never showed any fear, and in the last 10 minutes never got a shot.
